extracted.stage: Pre-grant; IHT due before grant of probate issues
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors enquires about a £73,000 probate loan to pay inheritance tax on a £445k estate ahead of the grant, which is expected in about eight weeks.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To take this further we will need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, a breakdown of the estate assets and any liabilities, and the date by which the inheritance tax payment falls due. It would also help to have the names of the executors, confirmation of your firm's instruction, and details of any other borrowing or charges against the estate property. Once we have these we will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please let us know if any further information becomes available in the meantime.
